scenario: [LNLS.3.3], a singleton pinned by construction. `Cpu` is `logical` with an empty key, so it holds at most one live fact ([LFAC.1.7.2]); `Mem` is keyed on `addr`, and the join pins that full key to a slot of the singleton (`m.addr == cpu.pcf`). A new `Cpu` token finds at most one `Mem`, and a new `Mem` fact finds at most one token, so the rule compiles under +nolinscan. PATH PINNED: `dsc.validate.lnls_3_3_anchors`, the singleton arm; without it this vector turns red with DS_VALIDATE_NOLINSCAN_JOIN_ANCHOR_A.
rules_ds:
use default:
    linear_scan: false

schema Cpu scope logical:
    pcf: Int mutable
    running: Bool mutable

schema Mem scope logical:
    addr: Int key
    amount: Int mutable

rule fetch:
    Cpu cpu where cpu.running == true
    Mem m where m.addr == cpu.pcf
->
    log info "fetch"
